district: Paso Robles Joint Unified School District
summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue up to $205 million in general obligation bonds for improvements at Paso Robles and Liberty high schools, repaid by a property tax on district property owners.

tax.text: A Yes vote would approve Measure G's school facilities bond, moving policy toward funding more district facilities.
tax.quote: The District previously approved placing a school facilities bond measure on the November ballot.

schools.text: A Yes vote would approve funding for the proposed improvements at Paso Robles High School and other district facilities described in the measure.
schools.quote: Construction of the project is contingent upon voter approval of Measure G in the November 2026 election.

tax.text: A No vote would reject Measure G's school facilities bond and would not approve the additional facilities funding described in the text.
tax.quote: The District previously approved placing a school facilities bond measure on the November ballot.

schools.text: A No vote would withhold approval for the proposed Measure G-funded district facilities improvements.
schools.quote: Construction of the project is contingent upon voter approval of Measure G in the November 2026 election.
